name: Fold Bitcoin Credit Card
summary: A no-annual-fee Visa credit card that earns up to 4% back in Bitcoin and allows users to build credit while spending.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required

faq.question: Does the Fold Bitcoin Credit Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Fold Bitcoin Credit Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the Fold Bitcoin Credit Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
